steps: A coordinator maps the key to three replicas.
A write succeeds after two replicas store the version.
A later read collects two replica responses.
Because R+W>N, the resolver can encounter and select the written version.

lesson.scenario: A three-replica cart store uses W=2 writes and R=2 reads to intersect on the newest version.
entities: Fans out versioned reads and writes

steps.title: Baseline N=3
steps.narration: All three replicas hold cart version 11.
steps.invariant: For strict quorum intersection, R + W must exceed N.

steps.title: Write fan-out
steps.narration: The coordinator sends version 12 to every replica.
steps.outcome: One durable acknowledgement is not enough for W=2.
steps.invariant: The coordinator must not report success before W replicas persist the version.

steps.title: Write quorum
steps.outcome: The client can receive a successful write response.
steps.invariant: Any read quorum of two intersects the two-replica write quorum.

steps.title: Read quorum
steps.narration: A read contacts stale R3 and current R2.
steps.outcome: The coordinator selects version 12 by version order.
steps.invariant: Quorum intersection exposes at least one acknowledged latest version, assuming replicas preserve it.

steps.title: Read repair
steps.narration: The coordinator repairs stale R3 with version 12.
steps.outcome: All replicas converge without blocking the original write.
steps.invariant: Version comparison must reject repair with an older value.
